scary_content.question: In this screenshot, are there pictures or visual elements likely to be scary, horrifying, or disturbing? Please note that this question does not refer to user-generated content.

scary_elements_includes.question: In this screenshot, select all visible scary or horrifying elements. (Scary elements: overall frightening theme for young children, e.g., haunted house, ominous atmosphere without specific violence. Horrifying elements: strong sense of threat/dread/terror, e.g., terrified characters, jump scare indications, threatening figures.)

scary_elements_frequency.question: In this screenshot, are there any scary elements visible? (Scary elements refer to frightening themes for young children, e.g., haunted house, ominous atmosphere without specific violence.)

horrifying_elements_frequency.question: In this screenshot, are there any horrifying elements visible? (Horrifying elements refer to strong sense of threat/dread/terror, e.g., terrified characters in danger, jump scares, threatening figures suddenly appearing.)

intense_and_unrelenting.question: In this screenshot, is there an intense and unrelenting sense of imminent threat visible? (e.g., characters being relentlessly chased by enemies intending harm, constant danger of immediate death/capture, restrained characters facing torture threats.)
